roadmap.goal: Story #6302: bring the Verify Frontend and Verify Backend jobs back near their early-October times and keep them there. Slice 01 settles the vite 8.3.4 suspicion by A/B; slices 02-03 speed up the eight slow new frontend test files; slice 04 measures, then cuts, the per-test host build in the Refinement, Reports and TeamFeatureSize harness bases; slice 05 explains the four 40-60 s backend outliers and fixes the ones waiting on nothing; slice 06 adds the test-time budget guard (check_budget.py, test-time-budget.json, the last step of both verify jobs, the DO-7 trigger paths, the ci-learnings rule). Done for this run when every evidence check E-01..E-05c that can be run locally is recorded under its slice's `## Wave: DELIVER` heading in feature-delta.md; the 42 tests in Scripts/test-timings/tests/test_check_budget.py are unskipped and green and `python3 -m unittest discover -s Scripts/test-timings/tests` reports 0 skipped on Python 3.12 and 3.14; `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` are green with zero warnings; `dotnet build` has zero warnings and the backend suite is green with `--filter "TestCategory!=Integration&TestCategory!=JiraIntegration&TestCategory!=LinearIntegration&TestCategory!=AdoIntegration&TestCategory!=ServiceNowIntegration"`. Nothing is pushed in this run: the CI medians (E-02b CI half, E-03b, E-04d, E-KPI), the budget recalibration on post-push `main` runs and both stacks' switch from warn to fail are owed after the maintainer pushes.
roadmap.paradigm_note: The Hypothesis + state-delta unit mandate from nw-roadmap does not apply, deliberately. Slices 01-05 change how fast existing tests run, not what anything does; the tests being sped up are their own behaviour oracle (D7), and acceptance is the evidence checks E-xx that DISTILL wrote as commands. Slice 06 is a Python 3.12-stdlib script whose acceptance tests are subprocess tests in stdlib unittest, example-based (DI-11; Hypothesis is not a dependency and DO-1 forbids adding one). RED for slice 06 is removing `@unittest.skip("pending — DELIVER slice 06")` from the tests a step owns and watching them fail against the scaffold, as DISTILL's red-classification records; GREEN is check_budget.py.
exit_gates: End of every slice 02-05: E-names (0 names lost, no newly not-passed name, per-file / per-class counts not lower) and E-weaken (skip grep prints nothing; every removed `expect(` / `Assert.` line paired with its replacement in the review note) recorded in feature-delta.md for that slice's files.
End of slice 04: E-04c, 3 consecutive green full-assembly backend runs with the standard filter, BackendTestParallelizationGuardTest green, no `[NonParallelizable]` added.

End of slice 06: E-06a `python3 -m unittest discover -s Scripts/test-timings/tests` 0 skipped on 3.12 (`uv run --no-project --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s Scripts/test-timings/tests`) and on 3.14; E-06c planted 120 s row on real data exits 1 with an `::error::` naming it (run without --warn-only), output pasted in feature-delta.md.

Owed after the maintainer pushes (not steps here, recorded as follow-ups in feature-delta.md): CI medians over >=5 `main` runs for E-02b, E-03b, E-04d and E-KPI; re-derive both budgets from >=5 post-push `main` runs (E-06b); remove --warn-only from the frontend step after >=5 post-push `main` runs; remove it from the backend step once >=5 backend `main` runs after the budget commit show zero budget warnings.

validation.notes: Written by nw-solution-architect from feature-delta.md (DISCUSS, DESIGN, DEVOPS, DISTILL), slices 01-06 and test_check_budget.py. Not yet reviewed.

user_decisions: D6 / DS-Q1 / ADR-237 - per-file (frontend) and per-class (backend) time budget read from the existing timing CSVs; B >= 2.1 x L and B <= 0.55 x the smallest regression to catch; JSON allowlist with reason and ceiling per entry; fail closed on unreadable input; self-tests run in the step.
D7 / DDD-9 - behaviour preserved: no test deleted, skipped or weakened; per-file / per-class names and counts unchanged or higher; a role query that is the assertion stays a role query.
D8 - the vite question is settled by a local A/B, >=3 runs per arm, alternated.
DS-Q2 / DDD-5 - host once per fixture, per measured harness, only where set-up dominates; per-test inputs reset in [SetUp] through fixture-owned objects; no new [NonParallelizable] (DDD-6).
DS-Q3 / DDD-8 - frontend fixes inside the existing kits (RefinementTabTestKit, WorkItemsDialogTestKit) where the cost sits in a kit helper, per file otherwise.
DO-1 - Python 3.12 stdlib floor; DI-13 refusal on older interpreters.
DO-3 / DI-7 - --warn-only softens budget breaches only, never a fail-closed input error, a stale allowlist entry or a failing self-test.
DO-4 / DI-5 - one `::error::` / `::warning::` annotation per finding, `%`, CR and LF percent-encoded; no tee into the step summary.
DO-7 - Scripts/test-timings/** added to ci.yml push paths and both ci_changes.yml patterns in the same commit as the guard steps.

DELIVER deviation (this run, see the ADR-237 amendment of 2026-10-14 and feature-delta.md `## Wave: DELIVER / [WHY] Upstream Issues`) - both stacks wired with --warn-only and a provisional budget calibrated on local post-fix timings, because nothing is pushed and no post-fix `main` runs exist.
out_of_scope: Runner type, sharding, Vitest pool / worker / coverage config, the live-connector categories, E2E jobs, older files that did not grow (DISCUSS out-of-scope).
A reusable host as the default integration base (DS-Q2 option B) and a shared DataGrid helper across kits (DS-Q3 option C) unless slices 02-03 earn it.
Finalize, push, ADO transitions, mutation testing and separate refactor passes: run separately, not steps here.

phases.name: Settle the 13 Oct dependency-bump suspicion
phases.description: Slice 01 / US-01. A local A/B of vite 8.3.2 vs 8.3.4 (then MUI and pnpm 12.10 if vite is clean) records a verdict; a fix ships only if a bump is guilty. Runs first: its result is the baseline the frontend slices measure against.

steps.name: An A/B on one machine says whether vite 8.3.4 slowed every frontend test
steps.description: Pin the test set to one commit. Run `pnpm vitest run` at least three times per arm, alternated A B A B A B (arm A vite 8.3.2 via `pnpm add -D vite@8.3.2 --save-exact`, arm B 8.3.4 as committed, restoring package.json and the lockfile between runs). Apply AC-01.2's non-overlap rule. If vite is clean, the same protocol once each for the MUI bump (641ac9c6f) and pnpm 12.10 (1bbde5105). Record everything under `## Wave: DELIVER / slice 01` in feature-delta.md; if a bump is guilty, pin or configure it and show the fix on the A/B.
files_to_modify: docs/feature/story-6302-ci-test-time/feature-delta.md (edit - A/B record: arm, version, commit, each Duration, median, min-max spread, machine, verdict)
Lighthouse.Frontend/package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml (edit - ONLY if the verdict finds a guilty bump and the fix is a pin; otherwise untouched, the arm-A change is never committed)
criteria: feature-delta.md shows, per arm, at least three Vitest `Duration` values from the same machine and the same commit, with their median and min-max spread.
The verdict follows AC-01.2: an arm counts as slower only when its fastest run is slower than the other arm's slowest run; otherwise the hypothesis is recorded as disproved.
If vite is clean, the MUI and pnpm 12.10 bumps each have the same record and verdict.
If a bump is guilty, the fix is committed and a fresh A/B run shows the fixed arm inside the faster arm's spread; if none is guilty, no file outside feature-delta.md changes.
No test file changes in this step.
steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: a measurement, not a contract; the oracle is the A/B record (E-01). CI runner variance (0.55-1.13) is why CI runs do not count here (D8). Close other heavy processes during the runs and note the machine. The test count in each run's summary must match across arms, or the run does not count. ESTIMATE: about 6 full Vitest runs x ~12 min per bump, up to three bumps (vite, MUI, pnpm 12.10), so up to ~3.6 h of runs; the 7 h is mostly wall-clock time with the machine running unattended, not hands-on effort.

steps.implementation_notes: EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: CI wiring and data; the guard's own tests run in the step on every CI run. DEVIATION (maintainer away, NOTHING may be pushed in this run, so no post-fix `main` CI runs exist to calibrate against; ADR-237 amendment 2026-10-14): (1) Calibrate a PROVISIONAL budget per stack with the DS-Q1 formula (B >= 2.1 x L, B <= 0.55 x the smallest regression to catch; frontend anchor the 115 s file, so B <= ~63 s), where L is the largest non-allowlisted unit in the post-fix LOCAL timing CSVs of the full suites. Produce them with the existing converters: frontend `cd Lighthouse.Frontend && pnpm vitest run --coverage --reporter=json --outputFile=<scratch>/fe.json` then `vitest_to_csv.py`; backend `dotnet test` with the standard filter, coverage as CI collects it, and a TRX logger, then `trx_to_csv.py`. For units the fixes did not touch, also take the most recent CI CSVs (`gh run download <id> -n test-timings-frontend|backend`) and use the larger of local and CI time per unit, because the local box is not the CI runner; record which source set L. Units breaking the lower bound go on the allowlist with reason and ceiling, and L is recomputed. (2) Wire BOTH stacks with --warn-only until real post-fix `main` runs exist, so the first push can never redden CI on an uncalibrated budget; warn mode still fails on unreadable input, stale entries and failing self-tests (DO-3). (3) The frontend's switch to failing (deleting --warn-only from ci_frontend.yml) is a recorded follow-up the maintainer does after >=5 post-push `main` runs, after re-deriving the budget on them; the backend flip follows ADR-237 decision 6. The deviation from DS-Q1 / DO-3 ('frontend fails from the start') is recorded in feature-delta.md `## Wave: DELIVER / [WHY] Upstream Issues` and in the ADR-237 amendment (both written at roadmap time). The JSON lives beside the script per DI-1 (Scripts/test-timings/), not at Scripts/ as slice-06 item 4 says, so the DO-7 path glob covers it. Use `python3` with no setup-python and no pip (DO-1); no pipe or tee on the check's output (DO-4). Do not push.
